official_code.title: gems-prize-reference-solution (U-Net + Monte-Carlo CV benchmark)
official_code.author: John Lipor (PSU) for DrivenData
official_code.config: MC=5, patch_size=128, test_proportion=0.5, batch_size=32, epochs=5, init_lr=1e-4, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, smp.Unet(resnet18, imagenet, in_channels=len(good_channels), classes=1), AdamW, TverskyLoss(alpha=0.2,beta=0.8,mode='binary'), RandomResizedCrop(0.5-1.0, 0.75-1.33, bilinear)+HFlip+VFlip+RandomRotation(30)
official_code.note: IR-47-004: the notebook contains NO DTI scorer. It optimises patch-level Tversky, which is not the leaderboard metric.
